limitations: Paper labels/control marks are not online schema verification; only fields with root_live_initial source have live initial-page evidence.
Most individual paper fields have no required mark; Section 1 completion instruction is not treated as proof every contact field is mandatory.
Root observed initial online enrollment without login; no customer values entered, and Next/signature/submission/confirmation inaccessible without real utility account information.
PEV and zero-income affidavit are follow-up flows, not universal initial enrollment documents.
Sub-metered repeated common fields reuse residential entries conceptually; exact layout differs.
2026 enrollment form income guidelines expire May 31, 2027; older indexed large-print PDFs may show expired 2026 limits.
PG&E public website and PDF show different ZIP+4 suffixes for same PO Box; verify current instructions before mailing.
